objective: Add the first GLiDE-backed Fast Decision Core path for evidence-aware compute-worker selection while preserving deterministic ComputeRouter and AER authority boundaries.

rulesConsidered: Deterministic eligibility and policy remain authoritative for compute admission.
Model probability and epistemic confidence remain distinct and provenance-tagged.
AER/Ascalon remains advisory until calibration and promotion gates pass.
Workers have no ambient authority; routing cannot grant capabilities or leases.
Physical artifact truth remains owned by verification/F07.

security.notes: No provider secrets are committed. GLiDE credentials are environment-only and the adapter validates the provider origin.

changes: Added GlideDecisionAdapter using Fastino /v1/systemone and X-API-Key authentication.
Added strict Noul, Choice, and Score response validation with confidence consistency checks.
Added bounded retry handling for 425, 429, and 503 plus fail-closed timeout behavior.
Added GlideWorkerSelectionAdvisor for closed-set worker selection using capability, health, load, latency, and deadline evidence.
Added optional shadow-only GLiDE integration to ComputeRouter.
Added adapter and worker-advisor contract tests.
Added the GLiDE .okf decision record and promotion gates.
notes: GLiDE is advisory/shadow-only in this change.
ComputeRouter hard eligibility gates remain authoritative.
The worker-selection advisor can select only from the deterministic eligible candidate set.
FASTINO_API_KEY is never included in prompts, state, telemetry, or committed files.
Authoritative GLiDE routing requires ShortForge-specific replay, calibration, latency, deadline-miss, false-reassurance, failover, and canary evidence.
verificationPlan: Pass GLiDE adapter and worker-advisor unit tests.
Pass strict FactoryOS typecheck and repository CI.
Pass Team Change Gate and affected-floor validations.
Run an explicit live GLiDE probe only with user-controlled Fastino credentials.
Keep the production router on deterministic selection until calibration/promotion evidence is sufficient.
After promotion, canary GLiDE selection against deterministic routing and verify automatic failover under worker/provider failure.
